 New hire IT onboarding Policy
Document owner
Sofie Claes, HR Policy Manager
Version
3.0
Status
Approved
Effective date
2025-01-01
Last updated
2025-12-28
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on new hire it onboarding at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
IT equipment is ordered 10 working days before the start date and the manager sends the welcome
plan 5 working days before the start date.
Conditions
External contractors follow the separate contractor onboarding flow.
Validity
Version 3.0, effective 2025-01-01. Supersedes version 1.2 (2022). Approved by the Management
Committee.
